Google Pay does not charge merchants any direct transaction fees in Vietnam or elsewhere. 
Merchant Costs
  • Google's Fee: Free. Google does not add a markup or extra charge for processing transactions through Google Pay. 
  • Payment Processor Fees: You only pay your standard payment service provider (PSP), bank, or point-of-sale (POS) terminal provider fees. These standard credit or debit card processing rates apply whether a customer taps a physical card or uses Google Pay on their phone.

AI Mode reply for google pay

Integrating Google Pay into your online platform through the Sacombank Online Payment Gateway gives your customers a seamless checkout experience while maintaining a standard merchant cost structure. 
Integration Options & Process
To accept Google Pay online via Sacombank, you do not integrate directly with Google. Instead, you integrate through Sacombank’s unified e-commerce API or plugin. 
  • The Mechanism: When a customer clicks "Pay with Google Pay", Google securely securely passes a tokenized version of their stored Visa or MasterCard to Sacombank. 
  • The Platform Integration: Sacombank provides modules and official SDKs for major global e-commerce platforms (like Shopify, WooCommerce, or Magento) as well as custom-built API pipelines. 
Associated Setup & Operational Fees
While Google Pay itself does not add a surcharge, utilizing Sacombank’s infrastructure involves specific operational components: 
  • Merchant Account Onboarding: Sacombank frequently runs support programs like eSME account packages, which waive initial connection or monthly service fees for qualified small-and-medium enterprises. 
  • PCI Compliance & Security: The gateway includes anti-fraud logic and runs on PCI DSS v4 standards. There is no additional cost to secure the tokenized Google Pay data, as the encryption is handled natively between Visa/MasterCard and Google. 
  • Settlement Timelines: Standard online payment settlements with Sacombank typically clear into your merchant account within T+1 to T+3 business days, depending on your industry risk profile and contract. 
Good to Know
  • NAPAS Card Limitation: As of late 2026, Google Pay in Vietnam predominantly supports Visa and MasterCard. Local domestic NAPAS cards cannot generally be used through online Google Pay gateways, so ensure you offer standard NAPAS QR or ATM card options alongside it. 
To help tailor the exact integration steps, let me know:
  • What e-commerce CMS platform (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce, Custom API) runs your store?
  • What industry or business sector are you in?
I can provide the corresponding technical documentation path or relevant contract templates.

AI Mode reply for sMerchant Account Onboarding acb bank

Switching your payment processing setup from Sacombank to Asia Commercial Bank (ACB) changes your gateway ecosystem to ACB2Pay, which is ACB’s dedicated e-commerce payment solution. Just like other banks, ACB does not charge an extra fee for Google Pay itself. Instead, you will pay their standard merchant card processing rates through the ACB2Pay gateway. 
Onboarding Steps for an ACB Merchant Account
To start accepting Google Pay (via tokenized Visa/MasterCard) online, you must clear ACB's formal compliance pipeline: 
Step 1: Check Compliance  ➔  Step 2: Submit Docs  ➔  Step 3: Verification  ➔  Step 4: Integration
(MoIT-Registered Web)     (Corporate Dossier)        (In-Person/Biometric)      (API & Go-Live)
  1. Verify Website Compliance: Your e-commerce website or app must be officially registered and verified with the Vietnam Ministry of Industry and Trade (MoIT). It must display explicit terms of service, payment refund, and complaint handling workflows. 
  2. Prepare the Corporate Dossier: Gather the required company legal documents:
    • Business Registration Certificate (Business License).
    • ID/Passport of the company’s legal representative.
    • Appointment decision of the legal representative or a formal Power of Attorney (if delegated). 
  3. In-Person Verification: Submit the files to an ACB Merchant Service Portal Hub or local branch. Corporate bank account setups at ACB undergo direct verification and biometric matching for security compliance. 
  4. Integration & Testing: Once approved, ACB provides access to their EBC (Electronic Banking Center) transaction checking tools and technical documentation for api integration. 
Cost Structure & Benefits
Fee CategoryDetails & Incentives
Google Pay Processing~2.0% to 2.5% standard fee for international cards (Visa/Mastercard) passed via Google Pay. (Actual markup varies by industry risk and monthly volume).
Onboarding & AdvisoryFree. ACB provides free pilot integration advisory and technical setup support.
Operational Banking FeesWaived. Under the "ACB NO FEES" corporate package, online account management, bulk payroll, and local interbank online transfers are 100% free.
Settlement TimelinesNext-working-day credit notifications with automated settlement into your ACB Corporate Current Account.

Since you already have an ACB corporate account, your onboarding path is much faster. However, because your website is brand new and not yet registered with the MoIT (Ministry of Industry and Trade), you will need to handle that registration first. 
Vietnam regulations strictly prohibit banks like ACB from linking live payment gateways (including Google Pay pipelines) to unregistered commercial websites. 
Here is your two-part roadmap to get Google Pay running on your new site. 
Part 1: Register Your Website with MoIT (Do This First)
Before ACB can issue you live API keys for your payment gateway, you must register your site as an E-commerce Website through the official portal. 
  • Where to register: online.gov.vn (The official MoIT E-commerce Portal). 
  • Process: Create an account using your Business Registration Certificate, fill out your website's domain, and upload your site policies (Refund, Privacy, Delivery, Terms of Service). 
  • Timeline: 7 to 10 working days. 
  • The Goal: Once approved, MoIT will provide a digital badge code to place in your website's footer. This badge links directly to your approval certificate, which ACB requires. 
Part 2: Activate Your ACB Merchant Account
While your MoIT registration is processing, you can contact your ACB Relationship Manager (RM) to begin preparing your merchant profile so you can move quickly once approved. 
  1. Notify Your RM: Inform your branch or RM that you want to integrate the ACB2Pay payment gateway for an online store using your existing corporate account. 
  2. Review the Technical Integration: Ask their tech team for the sandbox/testing documentation. Since it is a new site, you can have your developers begin integrating the payment gateway in "test mode" while waiting for compliance. 
  3. Submit the MoIT Proof: As soon as you receive your MoIT registration approval, submit the screenshot/link to ACB. 
  4. Go Live: ACB will switch your credentials from sandbox to live production, allowing you to accept Visa and MasterCard via Google Pay immediately. 
To ensure your brand new website passes both MoIT and ACB compliance on the first try, let me know:
  • What e-commerce platform are you building the new site on? (e.g., WordPress/WooCommerce, Shopify, or a custom stack)
  • Have you already drafted your Refund and Delivery policies on the site?

      Since you are using a Nuxt / custom stack, you have full programmatic control over your structure. To successfully pass the MoIT (Ministry of Industry and Trade) review and satisfy ACB’s risk compliance, your custom frontend cannot look like a placeholder or staging draft. It must function as a complete, live production environment. 
      1. Mandatory Legal Pages (Create These 4 Pages)
      Because you have not yet drafted your policies, you can use these exact content structures to build them. In Vietnam, these policies are strictly governed by Decree 52/2013/NĐ-CP and Circular 09/VBHN-BCT. 
      • Page 1: Chính sách Đổi trả và Hoàn tiền (Return & Refund Policy)
        • Must specify: Clear return conditions (e.g., within 7 days, tags intact), who covers shipping fees for returns, and processing time for card refunds (essential for ACB's Google Pay approval). 
      • Page 2: Chính sách Vận chuyển và Giao nhận (Delivery Policy)
        • Must specify: Shipping timeframes, delivery partner restrictions, inspection terms (whether customers are allowed to check the goods before paying), and how delivery disputes are resolved. 
      • Page 3: Chính sách Bảo mật Thông tin (Privacy Policy)
        • Must specify: Purpose of collecting data (e.g., processing orders), how long data is stored, third-party disclosure (explicitly stating data is shared with the payment gateway bank, ACB), and your business address for data deletion requests. 
      • Page 4: Điều khoản và Điều kiện Giao dịch (Terms & Conditions)
        • Must specify: Age restrictions, acceptable use, transaction limits, cancellation mechanisms, and governing laws in Vietnam. 
      2. Website Footer Requirements (The MoIT Hard Rule)
      MoIT reviewers will immediately scroll to your website footer on desktop and mobile. If this information is missing or inaccurate, they will reject your application instantly. 
      Your Nuxt layout component must display your exact corporate details matching your ACB Business Account: 
      • Full Business Name (Tên Công ty) as written on your Business License.
      • Tax ID Number (Mã số thuế) + date and place of issuance.
      • Headquarters Address (Địa chỉ trụ sở chính) matching your license.
      • Official Phone Number and Email Address for consumer complaints.
      • Note: Reserve a visual slot in the footer to embed the blue "Đã Thông Báo Bộ Công Thương" logo once approved. 
      3. Nuxt Technical Checklist for Compliance
      Because MoIT uses automated scripts and manual QA testers to verify custom frameworks, your Nuxt application must fulfill the following operational criteria: 
      • Production Domain Visibility: The site must be completely accessible on a public, top-level domain (e.g., yourstore.vn). Staging URLs or local environments (localhost, Vercel, Netlify previews) are rejected automatically. 
      • Functional Checkout Loop: A tester must be able to add an item to the shopping cart, enter an email/address, select a shipping method, and proceed to checkout. 
      • Active "Pay via ACB" Option: For the review phase, leave your ACB2Pay API connection in Sandbox/Testing mode. The reviewer needs to click "Pay" and see a functional checkout screen without it crashing or throwing a 500 Internal Server Error. 
      • SSR & Indexing Pre-checks: Ensure your dynamic page routing handles error handling gracefully. If the reviewer's automated bot triggers a 404, ensure it returns a proper server-side 404 status code rather than a soft-404 layout. 
      Next Action Step
      Draft these pages and ensure your footer matches your registration documents. 
      Would you like me to write a fully compliant template text (in Vietnamese) for either your Refund Policy or Delivery Policy so your team can paste it directly into your Nuxt project?

      # CHÍNH SÁCH ĐỔI TRẢ VÀ HOÀN TIỀN

**1. Điều kiện đổi trả**
Khách hàng có quyền yêu cầu đổi hoặc trả sản phẩm trong vòng [Số ngày, ví dụ: 07] ngày kể từ ngày nhận hàng thành công. Sản phẩm phải đáp ứng các điều kiện sau:
- Còn nguyên vẹn bao bì, nhãn mác, tem niêm phong (nếu có).
- Chưa qua sử dụng, chưa qua giặt ủi và không bị hư hỏng do tác động bên ngoài sau khi nhận hàng.
- Có đầy đủ hóa đơn mua hàng hoặc chứng từ thanh toán đi kèm.

**2. Các trường hợp chấp nhận đổi trả**
- Sản phẩm bị lỗi do nhà sản xuất hoặc bị hư hỏng trong quá trình vận chuyển.
- Sản phẩm giao không đúng chủng loại, mẫu mã, màu sắc hoặc kích thước như khách hàng đã đặt.

**3. Phương thức hoàn tiền**
Đối với các giao dịch thanh toán trực tuyến qua thẻ (bao gồm Google Pay qua cổng thanh toán ACB), khoản tiền hoàn lại sẽ được chuyển trực tiếp vào tài khoản thẻ mà khách hàng đã sử dụng để thanh toán.

**4. Thời gian hoàn tiền**
- ACB và hệ thống thẻ quốc tế (Visa/Mastercard) sẽ xử lý khoản hoàn tiền trong vòng [Số ngày, ví dụ: 07 - 14] ngày làm việc tùy thuộc vào quy trình làm việc của ngân hàng phát hành thẻ của khách hàng.
- Chi phí vận chuyển đổi trả sẽ do [Tên công ty hoặc Khách hàng] chi trả tùy thuộc vào nguyên nhân đổi trả.

      # RETURN & REFUND POLICY

**1. Return Conditions**
Customers have the right to request a return or exchange within [Number of days, e.g., 07] days from the date of successful delivery. Products must meet the following criteria:
- In original packaging, with all labels, tags, and seals intact (if applicable).
- Unused, unwashed, and free from any external damage post-delivery.
- Accompanied by the original purchase invoice or proof of payment.

**2. Acceptable Cases for Returns/Exchanges**
- The product is defective due to manufacturing or damaged during transit.
- The product delivered does not match the type, model, color, or size ordered by the customer.

**3. Refund Methods**
For online card transactions (including Google Pay processed via the ACB gateway), the refund will be credited directly back to the original card used by the customer during checkout.

**4. Refund Processing Time**
- ACB and international card networks (Visa/Mastercard) will process the refund within [Number of days, e.g., 07 - 14] business days, depending on the customer's card-issuing bank.
- Return shipping fees will be covered by [Company Name or The Customer] depending on the root cause of the return.

      # TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF TRANSACTION

**1. Age and Account Restrictions**
